name: farming
job: Map maize, soybean and other land from the NISAR season, before the official crop map is out
user: Crop analysts and agricultural agencies who need the crop map months before USDA publishes it
inputs: hh_db, hv_db, HV/HH for every Pass

labels.source: USDA Cropland Data Layer 2024 + 2025 (Iowa) with a maize/soybean rotation rule, because CDL 2026 is not published yet
labels.notes: The rule was 86% right when tested on 2025 from 2023 + 2024, so about 1 label in 7 is wrong; scores are capped by that

baseline.name: HV coefficient-of-variation rule (crop vs other; crops called the more common crop)

model.name: LightGBM on the per-pixel Pass series

extra_scores.name: Model, Passes up to 2026-08-31 only (before harvest)

split: Spatial 5-fold cross-validation over 2 km blocks; scores are out-of-fold
limits: Labels are a rotation-rule guess, not the 2026 crop map; rerun when USDA publishes CDL 2026 (usually early in the following year)
Fields that broke the rotation in 2026 are labelled wrongly
One county-sized area of central Iowa; other regions grow different crop mixes
Per-pixel at 20 m, so field edges are noisy
